newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK NATL MORTGAGE BANK SIGNS ACCORD WITH FANNIE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK NATL MORTGAGE BANK SIGNS ACCORD WITH FANNIE.

text.p: Greece's state National Mortgage Bank said it signed a six-month accord with the U.S. Federal National Mortgage Association (Fannie Mae) to get advice on mortgage procedures.

The agreement which was signed on February 11 aims to upgrade National Mortgage Bank's mortgage mechanism and improve the quality of its loan portfolio, credit control and to raise client satisfaction, it added in a statement.

Fannie Mae is listed on the NYSE and is the largest U.S. firm in terms of assets and the second largest bond issuer after the U.S. Federal government, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
